title: Browse Gyms & Fitness TV Commercials & TV Ads - iSpot

facts.fact: The iSpot Gyms & Fitness category page lists ten featured brands, including Fitbit, NordicTrack, and Orangetheory Fitness.
The iSpot Gyms & Fitness category page lists three product categories: Exercise Equipment, Memberships, and Mobile Applications.
The iSpot Gyms & Fitness category sits under the Health & Beauty section in iSpot's browse hierarchy.
Planet Fitness TV spots, such as 'Trampoline', appear first in the iSpot Gyms & Fitness browse listing.
